findings.headline: Three director share disposals filed in five days
findings.why_it_matters: Three Form 4 filings show directors reducing direct stakes ahead of the foundry update. Disposals on their own say little, but the clustering lands while the turnaround pillar is already under review.
bull: Two of the three disposals were made under trading plans adopted in May
Combined size is under 3% of the directors' disclosed holdings
bear: Third cluster of director disposals this year
Timing sits two weeks before the foundry milestone update

risk_views.aggressive: Reads the filings as routine plan activity with no bearing on the foundry timeline.
risk_views.conservative: Treats the clustering as worth tracking until the foundry update confirms the milestone dates.
risk_views.neutral: Notes that the plan adoption dates predate recent news, so the filings carry limited new information.

findings.headline: Disclosure points to a second large HBM customer for 2027 volumes
findings.why_it_matters: A regulatory disclosure and two press reports describe a supply agreement with a second accelerator maker. If it stands, the HBM leadership pillar rests on a broader customer base than it did last quarter.
bull: Reduces reliance on a single accelerator customer
Agreement reportedly covers 2027 volumes, extending visibility
bear: Press reports differ on contract size

risk_views.aggressive: Sees the agreement as confirming demand depth beyond one customer.
risk_views.conservative: Waits for the company's own figures, since press estimates of size vary widely.
risk_views.neutral: Records the disclosure as a positive data point with the scale still unknown.

findings.headline: Escalated: HBM revenue came in above the range implied in June
findings.why_it_matters: Quarterly results put HBM revenue above the range management implied three months ago, and the call raised the 2027 capacity plan. The watchlist scan escalated it for a full review because it also bears on the memory-cycle view behind two holdings.
bull: HBM share of DRAM revenue rose for the fourth quarter running
Capacity plan raised with customer commitments cited
bear: Capital spending guide rose faster than revenue guide
Conventional DRAM pricing commentary was cautious

risk_views.aggressive: Reads the results as evidence the memory upcycle is broadening.
risk_views.conservative: Focuses on the spending step-up and the cautious conventional DRAM tone.
risk_views.neutral: Notes the read-across to SK hynix and Samsung is supportive on HBM, mixed on commodity DRAM.

evidence.label: Results call
evidence.detail: Fiscal Q4 call, HBM and capacity remarks

findings.headline: HBM3E qualification wording softened on the results call
findings.why_it_matters: Management described qualification with a large customer as progressing, where last quarter it was expected to complete within the period. The catch-up pillar assumed completion this year.
bull: Management reiterated volume shipments to other customers
Foundry losses narrowed for a second quarter
bear: Second quarter in a row with the timeline moved
No date given for the next qualification step

risk_views.aggressive: Treats the wording change as timing noise inside a long qualification cycle.
risk_views.conservative: Reads a second slip as a pattern worth weighting in the catch-up pillar.
risk_views.neutral: Marks the pillar weaker for now, pending the next quarterly update.

findings.headline: AWS capital spending guide raised for the second quarter running
findings.why_it_matters: The 10-Q and call both lift the full-year spending range again, mostly for data centres. Cloud margin was steady this quarter, so the open question is how long margin keeps pace with the spending.
bull: AWS operating margin steady quarter on quarter
bear: Free cash flow fell year on year
Depreciation will rise as new capacity comes online

risk_views.aggressive: Sees the spending as matched by backlog and steady margins.
risk_views.conservative: Weights the free cash flow decline and the depreciation that follows.
risk_views.neutral: Records capex discipline as weaker while cloud margin stays steady.

evidence.label: Results call
evidence.detail: CFO remarks on the spending range

findings.headline: Supplier filings cite longer lead times for next-generation boards
findings.why_it_matters: Two Taiwanese suppliers mention extended lead times for accelerator boards in their monthly reports. The scan flagged it because the same supply chain feeds HBM demand for two holdings.
bull: Lead times usually lengthen when orders run ahead of capacity
bear: Could also reflect component shortages rather than demand

risk_views.aggressive: Reads longer lead times as a demand signal.
risk_views.conservative: Notes the same signal can come from supply problems.
risk_views.neutral: Keeps it as context for the HBM holdings rather than a finding on its own.

findings.headline: Interim report adds a separate line for mini-game revenue, splits domestic and international games, and restates two prior quarters on the new basis, so year-on-year games comparisons read differently for now
findings.why_it_matters: The restated segments do not change group totals, but the games pillar has been tracked on the old split. Comparisons need the restated quarters until four quarters exist on the new basis.
bull: More detail on the fastest-growing games line
bear: Older notes in the archive use the previous split

risk_views.conservative: Flags the comparison break for the next few quarters.
risk_views.neutral: Updates the games pillar baseline to the restated figures.

findings.headline: Two large US institutions reduced ADR stakes in the latest 13F filings
findings.why_it_matters: Both reductions were under a fifth of each position and came in a quarter when several banks were trimmed across the same funds. It reads as sector positioning rather than anything specific to the company.
bull: Total institutional ownership of the ADR rose overall
bear: Second consecutive quarter of reductions at one of the two funds

risk_views.conservative: Notes the repeat reduction at one fund.

findings.headline: Nothing material since the last run
findings.why_it_matters: Monthly operating statistics were in line with the recent trend. No filings or management remarks touched the thesis.

bull: Tracking difference stayed within its usual range
